newsitem.title: GERMANY: Economic crisis keeps Thai air cargo rates stable.
newsitem.headline: Economic crisis keeps Thai air cargo rates stable.

text.p: Air cargo market rates from Germany to Thailand will remain stable this autumn due to the Asian country's current economic crisis, a Thai Airways International manager said.
Both Thai Airways and Lufthansa Cargo AG had decided not to raise cargo rates to Thailand, Guillermo Valencia, the airline's cargo sales manager Germany, said.
Other airlines offering cargo space to Bangkok are now likely to follow their lead, industry observers indicated.
"With the catastrophic economic situation in Thailand there cannot be any rates increase. It would be completely wrong," Valencia told Reuters.

German air cargo shipments for Thailand were holding steady at present thanks to orders placed several months ago before the devaluation of the baht and subsequent IMF financial rescue package, he said.

But Thai Airways, which operates a joint twice-weekly Boeing 747-200 freighter service with Lufthansa between the two countries, foresaw a downturn in September once the economic impact affected new orders, he added.
